name: Westfield Valencia Town Center
description: Westfield Valencia Town Center is a premier enclosed regional shopping destination in Santa Clarita Valley, offering an exceptional mix of fashion, dining, and entertainment experiences. With over 170 stores including major department store anchors and popular national retailers like Zara, Uniqlo, and Sephora, this Westfield property delivers a comprehensive shopping experience for the entire family. The center features modern amenities including Smart Parking technology and click-and-collect services, making it a convenient one-stop destination in Valencia.
demographics: Westfield Valencia Town Center attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic with median household incomes above $100,000, primarily serving the Santa Clarita Valley area. The trade area consists of young professionals, dual-income families with children, and empty nesters aged 25-54 who value convenience and quality. Shoppers demonstrate a preference for mid-to-upscale retailers, dining experiences, and entertainment options, with strong weekend traffic from families seeking a full-day destination experience.
summary: A premier regional shopping mall in Santa Clarita Valley featuring 170+ stores, upscale dining, and modern shopping conveniences in an enclosed, family-friendly environment.
